Green flag or red flag?

They still text their mum every day? They want a joint bank account after three months? Make a quick call on 50 situations: green, red or beige, then say why.

Green Flag or Red Flag?1 / 50

They still text their mum every day.

Green, red, or beige. Say why.

Tip: arrow keys and swiping work too.

How to play

  1. Read the situation out loud.
  2. Both say it at once: green flag, red flag or beige flag (harmless but a bit odd).
  3. Explain your verdict. The truth often lives in “it depends”.
  4. It gets fun when a card fits one of you.
